race.description: Tabtouch Regional Championship: Road To Ascot Hcp
race.comment: IN SITU (2) has been very impressive at Geraldton in readiness for this Road To Ascot Final. He led and kicked away to win dominantly last start and while he carries the big weight, he looks to have a class and tactical edge on his rivals. Nottle's claim helps and he can bring up a hat-trick of wins. DIABLO LAD (10) was sound first-up behind a big winner before winning by 0.8L last start to earn his way here. Will need a touch of luck from the gate, but he has good tactical speed and Faithfull sticks with him. Only third-up and looks set to peak. MORF (4) has been freshened since a narrow defeat in the Kalgoorlie heat. Fiore riding is a bonus and he can go one better. DOOR BUSTER (7) is better than he showed last start and an improved run is on the cards.
